en-US.author: Termius Corporation
en-US.longDescription: Termius is a modern SSH client for Windows designed to enhance productivity by saving users up to 30 minutes a day. It offers features such as autocomplete for frequently used commands, split view and command broadcast for multiple terminal sessions, and multiple terminal tabs for easy navigation. Additionally, Termius provides a selection of terminal themes, an SFTP client for efficient file management, a port forwarding wizard, and terminal sharing for collaborative troubleshooting.
en-US.name: Termius Beta

zh-CN.description: 适用于 Windows 的现代 SSH 客户端
zh-CN.longDescription: Termius 是一款适用于 Windows 的现代 SSH 客户端，旨在提高工作效率，为用户每天节省多达 30 分钟的时间。它提供的功能包括：常用命令的自动完成、多终端会话的分割视图和命令广播，以及便于导航的多个终端选项卡。此外，Termius 还提供多种终端主题选择、用于高效文件管理的 SFTP 客户端、端口转发向导以及用于协作故障排除的终端共享。
